method: Attributed OSM component polygons, official plan labels and browser inspection of exterior photographs. Original source-authored mesh; no third-party mesh or reference image pixels copied.

sources.observed: Official current orientation labels identify the 26 named components. Text was read; PDF image was not visually inspected.

Visually inspected labeled plan: Crown Square has palace east, Great Hall south, Queen Anne west and memorial north. Hospital Square is separate in the northwest. Entrance and lower road approach from east.
Visually inspected southeast silhouette: palace high above exposed rock, curved flat-topped Half Moon Battery to its east, gatehouse much lower toward esplanade.
Inspected courtyard photo: narrow octagonal stone clock turret with horizontal bands, crenellated crown and tall flagpole; varied pale sash windows and stone palace facade.
Owner identifies eastern artillery battery built around remains of Davids Tower. It is not reconstructed as a tall freestanding keep.
Inspected courtyard facade: projecting side bays and central entry bay, crenellated parapets, round entry arch, tall framed niches, paired lower arched windows and broad shallow entrance steps.

identity: Exact Q212065 precinct way/4301292; components include individual building and building:part polygons and castle wall polylines. The precinct polygon is not an occupied building footprint.
limits: Relative ground levels, roof dimensions, openings, gun positions and landscape are provisional. Sculpture, heraldry, Foogs Gate and precise roof details require further work. Model is not a surveyed as-built reconstruction; geographic and maximum-fidelity reviews pending.
